scope: Entire 365.95-second Solo rules-test battle, setup through all 12 turns and final results
key_findings: After Will guaranteed the initial first coin as heads, Victory Star rerolled it to tails. The guarantee was not applied again to the replacement sequence.
Zangoose Counterattack returned 20 damage after a lethal hit, producing two knockouts and one point each. A zero-damage attack produced no return damage.
With two Victini present, an attack received one Victory Star reroll. Printed text explicitly limits the ability to one use per turn.
Bounded Field doubled a one-head Double Smash from 40 to 80 against Fire-weak ordinary Pokemon.
limitations: No Confused Pokemon attempts an attack in this recording.
The Mega Evolution ex exception, non-Fire attacks and broader Will interactions were not tested.
Hidden cards remain unknown; test choices are not competitive-policy grades.
